works.body:
この狐の女の子のキャラクターを描いてください。彼女は怪しげな組織によって実験台にされた九尾の狐の精霊です。組織に虐待されていたため、包帯を巻くなどダークな美的センスで描けます。彼女は逃げ出し、今はバブルタピオカティーを出す陽気なカフェを経営している。好きなように描いてください。

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1muwrNhirt7Rqdb6rTV-OLXttz7W9Ht94?usp=sharing

赤宮むむ様

普段から𝕏にて作品拝見させていただいていて、是非とも依頼したいと思いリクエストさせていただきました。

リクエストしたいのは、個人VTuberの満月まひろさんのイラストです。(三面図が掲載されているlitkinkはこちら→https://lit.link/mitsukimahiro)

満月まひろさんの配信してる様子(主に雑談配信)の日常の様子を描いていただきたいです。構図等は全てお任せします。

使用用途はXで依頼した旨の投稿、個人的な鑑賞、満月まひろさんへのプレゼントを予定しています。(配信のサムネ等の利用の可能性あり。商用利用なし。)

サムネ等に使用される可能性もあわせて、髪の毛は先端が見切れず全体が映るようにして頂きたいです。また、本人のみ(背景透過)と背景ありの2パターンで納品していただきたいです。

ファイル形式はPSDもしくはPNGで納品していただきたいです。

料金、また依頼文で不備等ございましたら再依頼で返していただけると嬉しいです。よろしくお願いします。

I would like to commission a street-style full-body illustration of Vtuber "Gurimu Tsukiuta".
I can leave the composition to you, except that I would like you to draw Gurimu looking up at me from below.
If you are going to draw a cap, please make sure the hair is either straight or tucked back into the cap.

Hello. Nice to meet you.
I love shioraven.
I purchased a book of mine clothing illustrations from BOOTH, and the cover alone, which is propped up on my bookshelf, is a feast for the eyes. It is wonderful to see it in a large size at hand. The fluffy and cute bibs are adorable too. I am looking forward to winter too.

I will request for our child (OC).
There is a simple character sheet (with skin color elements) at the bottom of the document URL.
We have also prepared a relatively wholesome material, but it also contains expressions similar to those in Young Magazine.
She is a slender, poor-breasted, semi-demonic girl with a cool visual with glazed eyes and flashing eyelashes, and a cute smile on her glossy lips. She is "slender and has poor tits.
As mentioned in the material, her tone of voice is polite, and her job is an adventurer and an anything-you-can-eat shop owner. She has a lot of piercings.

0Situation "Punkish Private Clothes Uchiko".
We request an OC wearing different clothes from those in the material.
Other poses, etc. are left up to you; you may dress her as she is dressed in the Advent book.
If possible, we would appreciate it if you can see the piercing on the left ear and the tongue piercing.

We may share your work at OC.


That is all. Thank you for your cooperation!

Mumu Akamiya

Nice to meet you.
My name is Yuka Kasumi and I am a personal Vtuber.
I have seen your very nice illustrations on X (formerly Twitter).
I would like to ask you to draw an illustration for me, so I have sent a request to you.

Usage: Thumbnails on YouTube, post on X (old Twitter)

I would like you to draw me, Yuka Kasumi, as the character.
Please refer to the following URL for the character design.

https://x.com/yuka_kasumi_vv/status/1956308469746946476?t=h_igLbdc15nS2N00hhSEAA&s=19

I will leave the pose and facial expression up to you, but I would appreciate it if you could make it look a bit girly.

As I mentioned earlier, we are planning to use it as a thumbnail.
We would appreciate it if you could make sure that the hair and other parts of the face are not visible.

If you can draw the background, we would appreciate it if you could send us a PSD or PNG file with the signature and background layered separately.
If you do not have a background, we would prefer a transparent background.

That is all.
Thank you for reading to the end.
We hope you will consider our proposal.
Thank you very much for your consideration.

Thank you very much for your kind attention.
We are planning to post an advertisement in support of Gawr Gura, a Vtuber talent belonging to Hololive, and are contacting you to request an illustration to be used in the advertisement.

Therefore, we would like to request a single picture of Gawr Gura with a background.
Please leave everything to us, including the composition.
The paper size of the supporting advertisement will be B0.
The company that has requested the advertisement has asked us to submit the data in full size, so if possible, we would appreciate it if you could deliver the data in this size.
We will send you the URL of the vendor's data submission as a reference.

https://help-cheering-ad.jeki.co.jp/hc/ja/articles/14088169727001

However, we will send the illustration to the vendor with the contact information of the organizer and a message to the talent, so please be aware that the size and settings are on a request basis.
However, if the size is too far from B0, there is a possibility of blurring or other problems when we enlarge the size to B0, so we would greatly appreciate it if the size is the original size or close to it.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
